summary.text: In January and October 2025, Waller anticipated long-run productivity and living-standard gains from AI while acknowledging worker displacement and short-term labor-market risks. In February 2026, he described System-wide AI deployment at the Federal Reserve and called for information-security controls, model validation, human accountability, and ongoing evaluation. In September 2026, he discussed AI's potential to improve payments efficiency alongside cybersecurity risks to payment infrastructure.
